notes: Ponte Coperto — covered bridge and chapel. Independently placed member of one Ponte Coperto candidate. Fixed geographic orientation, separate bridge-deck and stair-landing elevations, saved PMTiles routes and ordinary photographs. Detailed source preserved; shared graph materials and four browser tiers. Medium-fi exterior from five ordinary photographs, current PMTiles and unchanged standard Terrarium terrain. The retained184.52m covered body is separate from the reported216m overall crossing. Signed carriageway/paired-walk traces refine the retained axis by0.27427degrees. The near-central chapel replaces only its own mapped footprint. Deck grades and the compact three-return-flight western stairs adapt the coarse native terrain; these elevations and flight arrangement are visualization approximations, not a surveyed restoration. The final arch clears the unchanged north-bank path; the top stair landing follows the deck cross-slope. Hidden foundations, minor fittings and readable inscriptions are simplified. No bespoke survey, copied image texture or downloaded mesh. Physical laptop/phone timings and engineering clearances remain unmeasured.
